name: Aegyptosuchus
isnote: Placed in Aegyptosuchidae by PBDB; that family has no atlas clade, so the nearest atlas ancestor is used.
sum: Aegyptosuchus is an aegyptosuchid eusuchian crocodyliform from the Cenomanian Bahariya Formation of Egypt.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from the Bahariya Formation (Egypt) and Niger.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Stromer 1933
